## What

Brief description of the change and why. A `specs/` change ships with the implementation that satisfies it.

## Related issue

Fixes #<issue>, or N/A.

## Verification

Commands run and their results. A behavior change needs the scenario and observed result; a numerical or performance claim needs measured before and after values.

- [ ] `just ci` passes
- [ ] Changed behavior exercised through the real entry point
- [ ] No unrelated changes
